dataList.content:
... Did you really do it, Meursault?
……那真的是，默尔索先生干的吗？

As the manager and the rest were all present at the court for the trial and the sentencing, I don't suppose there is any need for further elaboration.
无论是经理还是你们，在审判期间应该都已经听过那天发生的事了，所以没有必要对此再进行补充。

Hm... I don't feel the need to question him further. I'm sure he must've had a reason for committing such an act.
嗯……看来我也无需再追问什么了。他这么做一定有他的理由。

Correct.
是的。

<But we only heard that through the prosecutor's argument.>
<可我们是从检察官口中得知的。>

<We'd like to hear your side of the story, Meursault.>
<我们……想听你亲口讲一遍。>

Strictly speaking, the prosecutor took no liberty with the truth of the matter.
如果仅从事实角度来说，检察官并没有说谎。

Perhaps, but it was plain to see that she did take quite a bit of liberty with the interpretation of it. She painted a picture of a remorseless murderer who has committed the heinous sin of matricide.
但她是按自身理解来进行诠释的。检察官把你描绘成了一个有违人伦，穷凶极恶的罪犯。

If "matricide" is to be defined as an act of murdering one's own mother,
如果将杀害父母等直系亲属的行为定义为有违人伦的话，

then there is no reason to deny her accusations.
并无必要对那人的话进行反驳。

<color=#a5ab8e>…….</color>
<color=#a5ab8e>……</color>

<color=#a5ab8e>An awful incident. Awful.</color>
<color=#a5ab8e>真是可怕的事件呢。</color>

<color=#a5ab8e>It was what all N Corp. newspapers talked about for a good while.</color>
<color=#a5ab8e>N公司的所有报纸，都将此事铺天盖地地报道了好一阵子。</color>

<color=#a5ab8e>Did you know? That incident even led to a total sales boom in the familicide genre of Canned Experiences.</color>
<color=#a5ab8e>正因如此，弑亲类型的经验罐头也风靡了好一阵子。</color>

<color=#a5ab8e>It was around then that cracks appeared on the Grand Magasin's walls... when the customers stopped rising after they fell and hit rock bottom.</color>
<color=#a5ab8e>这家百货店开始出现裂痕，跌落谷底的顾客们再也无法重新站起，也是从那时开始的。</color>

<color=#a5ab8e>Though a Giant had disappeared, her appropriate replacement just could not be found.</color>
<color=#a5ab8e>巨人消失了，但却找不到替代巨人的合适人选。</color>

<color=#a5ab8e>Do you think any of them has caught on to the fact that, for almost several years now on the outside, the "Voice" they've been worshipping and longing for...</color>
<color=#a5ab8e>啊，这些人知道吗？他们一生所崇敬的，苦苦思念的人……</color>

<color=#a5ab8e>... was a corpse all along?</color>
<color=#a5ab8e>实际上，是早已去世多年的人。</color>

<color=#a5ab8e>It's like people can't bear to live without believing in something, even in a place like this where the very idea of faith has next to no significance.</color>
<color=#a5ab8e>在这里，没什么比相信更没有意义的了，但大多数人如果不相信些什么，就无法忍受下去。</color>

<color=#a5ab8e>How about you? Look back on all those years you've lived outside the Grand Magasin, and tell me if you've ever held such faith in anything.</color>
<color=#a5ab8e>那么你呢？在外面的时候，有相信过什么东西吗？</color>

In the past, I had believed myself to be someone who would never take a step outside N Corp.
过去，我曾以为自己不会离开N公司哪怕一步……

I once had faith in that idea.
我曾如此相信过。

<color=#a5ab8e>Same here. But that's not exactly "faith," is it? It's just something that's been naturally ingrained in the residents of N Corp.</color>
<color=#a5ab8e>这点我也是一样。但这并非是相不相信的问题。因为对于在N公司生活的人而言，应该都会自然而然地这么想吧。</color>
